d:
Bihar ke navada men ek aisi nadi hai, jahan ka najara dekhkar aap bhi hairan rah jaenge. nadi men pani ki jagah charon taraph balu dikhaee de rahi hai, lekin isi balu ke niche chhipa hai pani ka khajana. aur isi pani ko nikalne ke lie chhath vrati nadi men chhote-chhote kuen bana rahe hain.
Ji han! lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath ke mauke par navada ke sabse bare sury mandir ke samip nadi ka yah adbhut najara dekhne ko mil raha hai. jahan barson se shraddhalu isi paranprik tarike se nadi ki balu ke niche se pani nikalte aa rahe hain.
